Return path

Source: R/dir.R
projr_path_get.Rd

Returns path to projr profile-specific directory. Differs from projr_dir_get in that it does not assume that the path is to a directory.

Will create the parent directory of the specified path if it does not exist, and ignore it if requested by _projr.yml.

Usage

projr_path_get(
  label,
  ...,
  create = TRUE,
  format = c("auto", "relative", "absolute"),
  safe = TRUE
)

Arguments

label

character. The built-in data label or a directory label declared in the active configuration.

...

Specifies sub-path of directory returned.

create

logical. If TRUE, then the parent directory is created if it does not exist and it is ignored (or not) from .gitignore and .Rbuildignore as specified in _projr.yml. Default is TRUE.

format

character. One of "auto", "relative" or "absolute". If "auto", then the format of the path returned is inherited from the format of the path specified in _projr.yml. If "relative", then the path returned is relative to the current working directory. If "absolute", then the path returned is absolute.

safe

logical. When TRUE (the default), stage outputs, documentation and package data under the configured cache for the current build version. When FALSE, return their configured final paths. Inputs and cache directories use their configured paths.

Value

Character. Path to directory requested.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
if (interactive()) {
  # EXAMPLE1
}
